title: Faqeer ki sada hussain hai
body:
Faqeer ki sada hussain hai
Ya hussain, ya hussain---hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
shah ast hussain, baadshah ast hussain
dee'n ast hussain, dee'n panah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar daad na daad, dast e dar dast e yazeed
haqqaq e binaye laa ilaah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Faqeer ki sada hussain hai..(4)
jo bandagi ka naaz hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
haqeeqat e namaz hai, wo banda e khuda hussain hai..(2)
1. Nazar hai khaimagaah par
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen o aasmaan ki
sukoot mein hai zindagi
<<DIVIDER>>
ghadi hai imtehaan ki
hai saans maut ki ruki..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
laraz rahi hai roshni
diya bujha raha hussain hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ae jaane wale ruk zara
udaas kyu hai is qadar
<<DIVIDER>>
qalam hai uske haath mein
hussain se to baat kar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye lauh phir banayega
tujhe pisar dilayega
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka laadla hussain hai..(2)
3. Sumo se zuljanah ke
<<DIVIDER>>
ye arsh kyu lipat gaya
falak pe mehr ruk gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
faraat peeche hatt gaya
hai zalzala zameen ko..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to aasteen ko
ulatne jaa raha hussain hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Falak pe likhe jaate the
naseeb kal ki baat thi
<<DIVIDER>>
kareem ke zahoor se
rawish ye ab badal gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi pe hoga sab raqam..(2)
uthake lauh aur qalam
<<DIVIDER>>
zamee'n pe aagaya hussain hai..(2)
5. Ameer ko salam kar
<<DIVIDER>>
kisine jab ye di sada
pukara muslim e ali
<<DIVIDER>>
mai qaid hu to kya hua
salam kyu karu ise..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
pata nahi hai kya tujhe
ameer bas mera hussain hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hussain ne ye tarbiyat
batool se hi paayi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
bachali apne khoon se
wilayat e ali wali
<<DIVIDER>>
gali gali, nagar nagar..(2)
ali ali hai ab magar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali ke lab pe ya hussain hai..(2)
Ya Hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ajab safar hai ishq ka
sukoon aablo'n mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
najaf se karbala talak
ye shor qaflo'n mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chalo hussainiyo chalo..(2)
zara sa tez aur chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe bula raha hussain hai
8. Wo apne dost ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
qaza ka sar utar de
majaal kya hai maut ki
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb ko jo maar de
hayaat maut layegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
palat ke ab to aayegi
zabaan de chuka hussain hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Takallum e hussainiyat
ye uska inteqaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki laadli se ab
qaza ka sab nizam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bata rahi hai ye zamee'n..(2)
yazeediyat kahi'n nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jagah jagah pe
ya hussain hai, ya hussain, ya hussain hai
author: Mir Hassan Mir
